So, What is a 3amjoke?

The idea is to tell the kind of jokes that would only make you giggle during sleep deprivation.

When I get tired I tend to get pretty loopy and crack some of the funniest - and in retrospect: dumbest - jokes ever.

Puns are a part of it but it's generally not required.

Never put the punchline in the title. Try to be a little vague.

A 3amjoke is:

A pun, a "dad joke", generally stupid at any hour other that around 3am.

A 3amjoke is not:

An anti-joke, any super low effort jokes like "yo momma" jokes.

Standard rules apply, be kind; we're all just here to laugh at stupid shit.
